newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BANNED VICENZA TO PLAY IN REGGIO EMILIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BANNED VICENZA TO PLAY IN REGGIO EMILIA.

text.p: Italian club Vicenza, banned from using their home ground for one league match after crowd trouble, will play Perugia in Reggio Emilia on Sunday.
The Italian soccer league gave the go-ahead to the neutral northern venue on Tuesday after Vicenza's first choice of Cremona was ruled out by local police.
Vicenza, struggling since leading serie A briefly in November and December, were punished after fans invaded the pitch during a home match against Lazio on March 23.
